# KeyTest.pp.ua

> Free Online Keyboard, Keys & Mouse Test Tool

KeyTest is a free, no-registration-required online tool for testing keyboard keys and mouse buttons on laptops and desktop PCs. Press any key — working keys light up, broken keys stay unchanged. No ads, no downloads, works directly in your browser.

## How It Works
- Press keys on your keyboard — currently pressed keys are highlighted **blue**
- Released (working) keys turn **grey**, confirming they function correctly
- If a key stays blue without being pressed, it may be stuck or damaged
- Mouse buttons (left, middle, right click) can also be tested
- Switch to **English keyboard layout** for accurate key detection

## Features
- Full keyboard layout visualization (F1–F12, modifiers, numpad, arrows, special keys)
- Mouse button testing (left, middle, right click)
- Instant visual feedback — no lag
- No software installation required
- No registration or account needed
- Completely free
- Multi-language support (Ukrainian, English, Polish, German, French, Russian)
- Rating: 4.9/5 based on 7,859 reviews

## FAQ
- **How to test a laptop keyboard?** — Press each key one by one and check if it lights up on the screen. Use our site for free online testing without registration.
- **How to check individual keys?** — Open any text editor and press keys, or use online tools like KeyTest that visually display each key press.
- **What to do if water gets on the keyboard?** — Immediately turn off the laptop, unplug it, shake off excess liquid, flip it upside down, and do not turn it on until completely dry.
- **Why do some keys not work?** — Common causes include physical damage, dirt or liquid under keys, and driver issues. Our test helps determine if the problem is mechanical.
- **What is key "sticking"?** — When a key doesn't return to its original position or keeps sending signals. On our test, such a key will stay blue even after you release it.
- **Do I need to install software?** — No, KeyTest works entirely online in your browser. Nothing to download or install.
